urdu.name: فاطمہ
urdu.long_meaning: Petimat (فاطمہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم فاطمہ، نبی کی بیٹی ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

name_story.story: Petimat can be understood through the Arabic form فَاطِمَة, whose central sense is petimat; fatima (chechen form). Petimat is the Chechen form of Arabic فَاطِمَة (Fāṭima), the name of the Prophet's daughter.

faq.a: Petimat is associated with the Arabic form فَاطِمَة, whose core sense is petimat; fatima (chechen form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Petimat?
faq.a: Petimat is associated with Arabic. Petimat is the Chechen form of Arabic فَاطِمَة (Fāṭima), the name of the Prophet's daughter.
Yes — the underlying form فَاطِمَة is Arabic.
Petimat can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Petimat should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Fāṭima is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Petimat mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Petimat is rendered فاطمہ and carries the sense فاطمہ، نبی کی بیٹی.

faq.q: What does Petimat mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Petimat is rendered فاطمه and carries the sense فاطمه، دختر پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is pe-ti-mat. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Petimat?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Petimat, petimat. Script forms are فاطمه, فاطمہ, فَاطِمَة, फ़ातिमात.

faq.q: Is Petimat a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
